text:
mike: quick heads-up — ran a short afternoon sim for the evening shoulder (18:00-22:00 UTC) with the new multiplexing config. result: tokens/sec flattens around 1.9M when concurrent requests exceed ~2.3k on the a100 pool.

ana: do you mean 1.9M total tokens/sec across the pool or per-GPU?

mike: total across the pool. per-gpu drops to ~430k tokens/sec because of longer tail requests and token mixing from chat sessions.

jess: did you include prefix cache hit rates? that can swing effective throughput a lot for chat workloads.

mike: yep, 35% cache hit baseline in this sim. i re-ran with 50% hit and total tokens/sec jumped to 2.5M at same concurrency.

sam: interesting. what was the model mix and average seq len?

mike: model mix: 60% chat-medium (6B), 30% chat-large (13B quant), 10% longform (13B full). avg seq len ~120 tokens, 95th ~640.

jess: so longform tails are killing batching efficiency and kv cache locality.

mike: exactly. here's the little formula i used for headroom calc:

```
provisioned_tokens_per_sec = num_gpus * effective_tokens_per_gpu
expected_peak = median_peak_tokens_per_sec * promo_multiplier
safety_headroom = provisioned_tokens_per_sec - expected_peak * 1.15  # 15% safety 
```

mike: plugging numbers: provisioned=320 gpus * 430k = 137.6M tokens/sec (pool-level, theoretical), sim-effective throughput with current mix ~1.9M -> shows we're well under theoretical because of serialization and long-request tails.

ana: can you convert that to GPU-hours for a 4-hour evening window for the worst-case promo scenario? need to budget extra reserved capacity if we want <2% p95 latency SLO miss.

mike: worst-case promo multiplier 1.8x. to keep p95 slowness under 2% we'd need an extra ~40 GPUs in the a100 pool for the 4-hour peak -> ~160 GPU-hours. cost ballpark: at current committed rate that's ~ $2.2k for that window.

sam: think about cheaper options: i) shift some longform to pre-warmed smaller models, ii) increase prefix cache eviction TTL for chat sessions, iii) use burst standby in eu region to avoid cross-region egress.

jess: note: EU egress costs for cross-region fallback spike by ~3x and adds 80ms median RTT, which kills p50 for interactive features. not ideal.

ops-bot: scheduled-sim finished: https://internal/sims/1777777777 (outputs + per-gpu traces) :white_check_mark:

mike: next steps i propose: 1) run a 7-day promo sim with 50% cache hit and 1.8x multiplier to get realistic GPU-hour delta, 2) test TTL bump for prefix cache on a canary pool, 3) estimate cost for +40 a100 reserve vs throttling degrade policy.

ana: +1. i'll start the 7-day sim and share results by EOD.

jess: i'll take the canary TTL test, plan to roll to eu-canary tomorrow morning.

sam: i'll model the reserve vs throttle ROI and include egress penalty numbers.

mike: great. keep the thread updated. if the 7-day sim shows >200 GPU-hours extra we escalate to finance for short-term reserve purchase.

ana: noted. thanks all. :thumbsup:
